intro: Give your app pretend services to call. Copy an example, change its JSON and test both normal and failure responses.
noNode: Install a Node.js runtime in FlyEnv first. Mockoon requires Node.js 18 or newer.
unsaved: Save your changes before starting or restarting Mocktoon.
name: Mock
noProfiles: Create an editable copy from Examples & editor to get started.
local: Enabled mocks run together on 127.0.0.1. Point your application's integration URLs at the matching base URLs.
editable: These are examples to copy, experiment with and adapt. Each copy is independent of the shipped template.
editHelp: Edit routes, response bodies, status codes, headers and latency. Save, then restart to apply changes. New custom responses can use Request rules.
historyHelp: Shows up to 100 recent transactions from the current session. Expand a row to inspect submitted data. Request bodies can contain sensitive data; use test data. Starting a new session clears its previous log.
logHelp: Use this log to investigate invalid configurations or ports that are already in use.
skipped: Some profile files could not be loaded; valid profiles remain available.
